title: Indonesia District MO
text:
The Indonesia District MO (or in Indonesian, Olimpiade Sains Nasional tingkat Kota (OSN-K)) is the first of a series of three tests, or the first qualifying test for entering the national-level Indonesian Mathematical Olympiad.

Structure[edit]

The structure of the tests have changed multiple times over its history.

2002-2008: Consisted of 10 multiple-choice questions and 10 short answer questions, all of which carried 1 point.

2009-2018: Multiple-choice questions were replaced with more short answer questions, leading to 20 short answer questions, still carrying 1 point each.

2019-: The 20 questions were split into 2 sections, 10 "Basic Ability" questions carrying 1 point, and 10 "Advanced Ability" questions carrying 4 points.
